Name: Bird Cove
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=3]The Cove has tons of [b]wildlife[/b] and a [i]few little secrets[/i] to be found around! 

The Forage on the beach is [b]Freshwater Crab pot fish[/b], and the forage in the grassy area is normal seasonal forage.

The cave on the Left side of the Beach can spawn some resources, including [b]clay [/b]clumps, [b]coal [/b]nodes, and [b]jade [/b]nodes.

Bird Cove Should be [b]Compatible[/b] with most mods including:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Bird overhaul Ornithologist's Guild[/url]﻿ (highly recommended for more birds!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29376]Northwest Coast[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24852]Coal Point Farm[/url][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11571]Backwoods Extra Area[/url]﻿[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿﻿[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial[/url]﻿[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]let me know if any mods have compatibility issues

Installation:
﻿[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28480]AToMS[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install Bird Cove[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3](I also recommend installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url] so you can get all the foliage I added)[/size]

[size=3]Chinese Translations: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Shenyifan]Shenyifan[/url][/size][size=3]
Spanish Translations: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/NandemoXV]Nandemo[/url][/size]
